# Apollo Connector for Muse

💳 Paid API required: this connector needs a paid third-party API — the listing is free, but usage is billed. See Prerequisites for costs.

A Muse agent skill that searches Apollo.io's B2B database: find people by title, location, and company, and enrich a person or a company. Searching is free and needs no confirmation; enriching consumes Apollo credits — the skill warns you before enriching more than a single record. Honest note: Apollo API access requires a Professional plan or higher; on lower plans the API returns errors. Draft: written from Apollo's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
